## Keywords

## What AI does well: a first draft

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- An AI assistant learned from a huge amount of text: its training data.
- It writes likely words, so it is fast, but likely is not always true.
- It does five jobs well: drafts, summaries, ideas, rewrites and translations.
- You check every fact of a draft and delete what the AI added.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/ai-good-jobs.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · Good jobs for AI

a) Which good job is "Give me the main points of this 3-page report"?
b) Which good job is "Make this e-mail shorter and more polite"?
c) You send the same prompt in a new chat. What can happen?

::: {.answer}
a) a summary
b) a rewrite
c) a different answer, so you check it again
:::

## Five weak spots of AI answers

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- AI can invent a book, a name or a link: this is a hallucination.
- It can give old information from before its knowledge cutoff.
- It can make wrong numbers, and it can repeat unfair ideas: bias.
- It does not know your class, job or company: missing context.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/ai-weak-spots.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 2 · Which weak spot?

a) The AI names a book that no library or shop has. Which weak spot is it?
b) It is 2026, and the AI says the newest app version is from 2021. Which weak spot is it?
c) The AI writes "We need a nurse. She must be kind." Which weak spot is it?

::: {.answer}
a) an invented fact (a hallucination)
b) old information (its knowledge cutoff)
c) bias
:::

## AI, search engine or spreadsheet?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Use an AI assistant for drafts, summaries, ideas and translations.
- Use a search engine for today's facts, and read the real source.
- Use a spreadsheet for exact sums and averages.
- With AI, you ask, read, check, edit and use, in this order.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/tool-choice.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 3 · Which tool?

a) Which tool is best for the last day to apply for a scholarship?
b) Which tool is best for the average of 30 test marks?
c) You have an AI draft. Which step comes after "read"?

::: {.answer}
a) a search engine
b) a spreadsheet
c) check
:::

## Summary

- An AI assistant writes likely words from its training data, so it is fast but not always true.
- It writes drafts, summaries, ideas, rewrites and translations very fast.
- AI answers can have invented facts, old information, wrong numbers, bias or missing context.
- You check numbers in a spreadsheet and facts on the official website.
- With AI, you ask, read, check, edit and use, and you are responsible for the result.

## Results of the worksheet

Which results do you have in your table?

::: {.reveal}
- Experiment 1: The draft keeps every fact of the prompt, and a new chat gives other words.
- Experiment 2: The class's bill is 9.00 JD in the spreadsheet, whatever the AI says.
- Experiment 3: The university website wins, and each job has its own tool.
:::

## Try it 4 · Omar's newsletter (harder)

The facts: sales were 3 500 JD in September and 4 200 JD in October. The shop is open Saturday to Thursday. The company won no awards.

a) The AI writes "a rise of 1 200 JD". What is the real rise?
b) Which weak spot is the AI sentence "We won the Best Shop award in 2025"?
c) Why is the AI sentence "The shop is open every day" wrong?

::: {.answer}
a) 700 JD
b) an invented fact (a hallucination)
c) The shop is closed on Friday.
:::
